C1343.title: Post-quantum cryptography industrialization accelerates with first financial deployment
C1343.summary: In May 2026, Chinese computing hardware vendor Hygon Information, Haitong Securities, and Koal Software jointly announced the world's first smooth migration solution for post-quantum cryptography in a financial production environment.
